principle: Trained operators optimize concealment+egress+RF, not maximum elevation.
notes: mid_elevation: inverted-U around ~15m building height; penalize unique skyline ridges
egress_access: road 40-350m sweet spot; prefer off-axis from inbound bearing
concealment: industrial/residential blend; bare military tags without corroboration down-weighted
fusion: P' ∝ P_rf^(1-mix) * H^mix with mix≈0.42
AI API is optional post-filter only — core ranking never depends on it
